description: (needs account token) Sets or removes a site's browser icon (favicon) or share image (the picture shown when a link is shared). content is the image as base64. clear true removes the current image. Available once the site has its own domain. Does not charge.

content.description: The image file as standard base64 (PNG, JPEG, SVG, ICO, WebP).

file.description: Local server only: path to the image file on this computer.

filename.description: Optional: the file name, e.g. logo.png.

site.description: The address of a site on this account, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app.

name: set_site_image
title: Set site image
